transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Just... having some trouble. Um. It's like... I got a motor running inside me all day. If I have to sit still—like at church, or here at the clinic, or even just at home... I don't know, I feel trapped. I just have to get up and do something. So... that's why I'm here.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized, needed less sleep, or were more talkative than usual, along with this restlessness?
Nah... I don't think so. It ain't like... a phase or nothing. It's just always there. I sleep alright, I guess. And I don't really talk much anyway, so... no.
Do you often feel worried or anxious, even when there's no clear reason for it?
Um... no. Not really. I ain't much of a worrier. Just... I don't know, I don't really sit around worrying about stuff. So... no.
Do you find yourself acting on impulse, like doing things without thinking them through, or taking risks without considering the consequences?
Uh... no. Not really. I mean... I just do stuff, I guess. I ain't out there taking big risks or doing crazy things, if that's what you mean. So... I don't think so.
Do you often feel down, sad, or lose interest in things you used to enjoy?
No, I don't think so. I ain't really sad or nothing. Just... normal, I guess. I still do whatever I usually do. So... no, not really.
Do you find it hard to focus or concentrate on tasks, like reading or following conversations?

Well... sometimes, I guess. Like... if folks are going over ride times, or... pantry lists, church plans, stuff like that. I listen good at first. But then... I don't know, my mind just sort of slips off. I end up missing pieces I really needed to hear. So... yeah.
Do you remember having similar difficulties with restlessness or focusing when you were younger, like in school or during family activities?

Yeah... I guess so. Back when I was a boy in school... teachers were always moving my seat around. Just... couldn't stay put, I guess. I'd talk out of turn... and I always got in trouble for jumping up before class was even done. So... yeah. It was like that.
Do these difficulties with restlessness and staying focused cause you any real problems in your daily life—like at work, in relationships, or when you're trying to get things done?

Yeah... I guess so. Folks at the church... and the food pantry... my family, too. They kind of... stopped trusting me with things. Like doing rides, or keeping track of appointments... handling supplies, stuff like that. I don't really like talking about it, but... I just feel like I keep letting everybody down. Even when I really mean to help 'em out. So... yeah. It causes problems.
